_readme: Only add sources whose content is published FOR reuse: official press rooms (Govern, Consells, Ajuntaments),
public bodies, statistics offices, clubs' and companies' own press releases. Check each site's 'Aviso legal'.
Do NOT add other newspapers (Diario de Mallorca, Ultima Hora, Majorca Daily Bulletin, Mallorca Zeitung, etc.).
type: 'rss' (RSS or Atom feed URL). Set enabled: true once you have pasted and checked a real feed URL.
maxPerRun limits how many stories one source can add each run.
